issue_request: FHIR-12411 asked FHIR-core vocab to fix v3 CodeSystems that used notSelectable on concepts without declaring notSelectable as a CodeSystem property; Jira status is Published with Persuasive resolution and applied-for DSTU2.
initial_application: The Jira application comment cites SVN revision 10485. Git commit 7c8e9905e8ef3b09c7be11999ffea661be2f3b1c maps to that revision and changed the old DSTU3 terminology utilities/publisher path to treat notSelectable as its own defined property rather than the older abstract/inactive handling.
additional_context: The old Java implementation changed by the application commit is no longer present in the current core checkout. Current core references v3 terminology through terminology.hl7.org and the current core package does not embed the target v3 CodeSystems. The current v3 MIF source and THO package/live JSON surfaces for the six named systems do not use notSelectable, so there is no current undeclared notSelectable property to correct in core.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The combined branch received an empty no-change audit commit documenting that the current source and conformance artifacts are already correct for the reported defect.
